settings.title: Settings
settings.audioHint: Master switch for click ticks and the completion gong.
settings.warmupHint: Before each session, stare at a single center point for 60 seconds to contract attention. Press Esc to skip.
settings.defaultDailyGoalHint: Saved locally. Defaults to 180 minutes (3h). Today’s ad-hoc adjustments live alongside it and reset at midnight.
settings.todaysGoalHint: Ad-hoc override for today only. Resets to default at midnight.
settings.dayResetHint: Late-night focus blocks completed before this hour count toward the previous day.
settings.weekStartHint: Controls weekly stats and the alignment of the activity grid.
settings.notifHint: We’ll ping you the moment a session pushes you past your daily goal.
settings.languageHint: Switch the interface language. Saved on this device.

legal.disclaimerBody: The content of this application has been created with the greatest possible care. However, no guarantee can be given for the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of the content.
legal.overviewBody: Hourglass is a minimalist focus application. We only process the data required to provide the core service — nothing more. No tracking, no advertising, no sharing with third parties for marketing purposes.
legal.authBody: Email address and (for password login) a hashed password, managed via Supabase Auth.
legal.productivityBody: Sessions, projects, goals and statistics you create. This data is strictly bound to your user ID.
legal.storageBody: All data is processed and stored exclusively with Supabase on EU-based infrastructure. Row Level Security ensures at the database level that each record is only readable or modifiable by its owner (auth.uid() = user_id).
legal.legalBasisBody: Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in a functioning, secure service).
legal.yourRightsBody: You have the right to access, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability and objection at any time. Your productivity data can be viewed directly in the Analytics and Profile view and deleted individually or completely. For complete deletion of your account, an informal message to [Contact Email] is sufficient.
legal.cookiesBody: We do not set tracking cookies. Data required for operation (session token, locally cached sessions, settings) is stored in your browser's localStorage and only leaves your device to sync with Supabase.
legal.complaintBody: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your data violates the GDPR.

focusBlocks.title: Focus Blocks
focusBlocks.subtitle: Chain focus and break intervals into a rhythm. When activated, the main timer flows through every block back-to-back — no re-configuring between rounds.
focusBlocks.buildOneHint: Build one by chaining focus and break blocks in any order.
focusBlocks.activatedDesc: The main timer will run through this rhythm.
